name: J850 TechStyle
summary: PolyJet printing directly onto textiles for fashion and soft goods.

page.description: Stratasys J850 TechStyle 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Direct-to-textile
page.lead: 3DFashion technology prints full-colour, multi-material designs straight onto fabric, garments, footwear and accessories, with up to seven materials in one job.
page.footnote: Source: stratasys.com J850 TechStyle page, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: Direct-to-textile
features.text: Prints onto fabric and finished garments.

features.title: 3D accessories
features.text: Buttons, cufflinks and clips up to 50 mm high.

features.title: Full colour and transparency
features.text: Up to seven materials at once.

benefits.title: Faster sampling
benefits.text: Tangible prototypes in hours instead of weeks (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: On-demand production
benefits.text: Localised manufacturing with less unsold stock.

specs.label: Print area
specs.value: Effective 460 × 360 mm; fabric at least 560 × 460 mm, 0.1–3.0 mm thick; interchangeable tray

specs.label: Print modes
specs.value: High Mix: up to 7 resins, 27 µm · High Speed: up to 3 resins, 27 µm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: Under 100 mm: ±100 µm. Over 100 mm: ±200 µm or ±0.06 % of part length, whichever is greater (typical, rigid materials)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: VeroEco Flex, Vero, VeroVivid, Agilus30 Colors

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Printer Connectivity SDK

specs.label: System size & weight
specs.value: Printer 1,400 × 1,260 × 1,100 mm · 430 kg; material cabinet 1,119 × 656 × 637 mm · 153 kg; Fabric Alignment Station 91 × 81 × 215 cm · 142 kg

applications.title: Footwear and accessories
applications.text: Hybrid shoemaking and full-colour luxury accessories.
